## Structure of the workshop {.smallish}

- **Six modules**, each about **25 minutes**.
- Per module: **~17 min** of slides, then **~8 min** on a hands-on **exercise**.
  - Module 1's exercise is take-home — no live coding.
- A **15-minute break** after Module 3.

::: notes
Timing is a guide, not a stopwatch. 17 + 8 per module × 6 ≈ 2.5 hours, plus the break.
:::

---

## Running the code {.smallish}

- **Posit Cloud** — no local install needed. The join link is shared **live** at the
  start of the session; the space stays active until **~September 20**.
- To run it **locally** (now or later), the repository is public and will remain available:

::: {.accent}
<https://github.com/khanna-lab/ssc-ergm-hepcep>
:::

- Each module has a matching exercise under `exercises/`; a shared Posit project has the
  environment pre-built (`renv` restored, synthetic data in place).
